position_outside: UN/LOCODE places Ibeju-Lekki at (6.4333, 4.0), a rounded position a few tens of metres outside the north-west corner of these limits, on the free trade zone's land behind the port.

properties.source: Derived: the convex hull of this port's terminals from OpenStreetMap, grown by 300 m, then cut to the water OpenStreetMap maps inside it (the sea within its coastline, rivers, docks and basins), with the terminals kept whole
properties.note: OpenStreetMap maps no port limits for Lekki. These are the hull of the port below grown by 300 m, cut to the water OpenStreetMap maps inside it, with the port kept whole and a 30 m margin where it meets the water: the port and its basin inside the breakwater, not the free trade zone's land behind it. A scan of OpenStreetMap finds no homes, residential land, schools, hospitals, places of worship or named places inside.

properties.name: Lekki Deep Seaport
properties.note: The deep-water port opened in 2023. Its container terminal is run by Lekki Freeport Terminal, a CMA CGM group company. OpenStreetMap names it Lekki Deep Seaport.
